title: Read
say: A token is only text. Decoding shows what it says, offline. Anyone can write any claims, so nothing is trusted until the signature is checked.

title: Break
say: Fifteen wrong tokens are sent to a stub resource server. A correct one refuses each for the right reason, with the right error.

title: Check
say: Five stub authorization servers are probed against OAuth security rules. The FAPI 2.0 pack is UNVERIFIED.

title: Compare
say: PKCE, PAR, RAR, DPoP, mTLS and JAR each stop one attack. This is a simulation of the mechanisms, not of any product.
